paragraphs: The XF 2.0 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted to the X250 generation from 2007 until the model's discontinuation in 2015, offering a more efficient petrol alternative to the diesel and larger V6/V8 units in the range. The engine shares its architecture with the wider Ford EcoBoost family used across multiple Ford and Jaguar Land Rover models of that era.
about.boldParagraph: The XF 2.0 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the XF 2.0 from 2007 to 2015 (X250 generation). No widely-reported engine issue for this variant — we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey.
